module_contract.limited_to: Explicit Clang -fmodules with -fno-implicit-modules; not standard C++20 modules. The project wrapper replaces -MMD with -MD so depend mode tracks system headers too.
module_contract.reason_for_modules_sloppiness: Upstream requires modules sloppiness with direct+depend modes; 4.14.2 hashes explicit -fmodule-file contents. Do not add other sloppiness or permit implicit module caches.
module_contract.fallback: Unsupported compilations are passed to the compiler without cache; the first compilation and linking remain real work.
